review_findings.candidate02: Moved actual bank construction after both charges but before open_roots; resolved in reviewed delta

review_findings.candidate01: check() entered tracked parent FD verification before State/Failed/device gate
review_findings.candidate02: State gate held through verify; all eight check callers precede their own State acquisition and observe callers explicitly release State first; no recursive locking at those sites

scoped_positive_findings: H+1 fixed slot count shared by planning/allocation and charged through installed owner; new inline fields covered by size-derived terms, added native mutex allowances explicit; real mutexes warmed before file FD acquisition, empty retirement placeholder allocates none

FilePreparation reserves slot and owns warmed resources before acquire_parent; each acquired FD is installed before metadata/identity checks; errors/unwinds transfer to fixed installed custody while State remains held

PreparedPublication explicitly drops destination preparation before source FileOwner; unsuccessful exclusivity cannot acquire a destination FD; success transfers parent/name/binding before post-rename fallible synchronization; old parent closes before scalar parent credit
Normal FileOwner retirement uses the map Weak to retain the original Arc allocation while data/parent FDs and metadata backing retire; removes the exact Weak before registration/slot becomes reusable

Retirement guard moves unfinished resources into reserved custody during unwind; uncertain native close retains actual original io::Error and diagnostic integer, blocks census and never retries the integer

stat_leaf uses one component plus AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW and preserves regular type, link count1, device, effective UID and private mode checks from regular_nonallocating; enrolled-target size/block arithmetic is checked
Existing directory verify/retire remain separate; reviewed file call paths use verify_file/retire_drained
Four native custody regressions plus candidate02 fence regression retain the intended assertions; no runtime pass inferred
qualification_limits: No native/Cargo run by this review; source/harness compilation and tests remain required

A successful complete census is the documented explicit relinquishment boundary for already terminal attempts; cancellation and unknown native close cannot reach it. This is scoped policy, not a proof of every production caller choosing it correctly

Opaque io::Error/panic payloads, destructor panic/report envelope and total allocator/RSS remain open; NodeDiskFile::identity inherited descriptor_identity->io::Error::other path remains outside new native error geometry
Configured-root acquisition, ordinary DirectoryOwner/native directory destructor protocol remain separately open
check holds State only through tracked verify; some subsequent inherited metadata/identity observations are outside that guard
No complete arbitrary filesystem-race, whole-operation mutation rollback or full release acceptance claim
